data.title: Reliability test for the experimental results of electric quadrupole hyperfine structure constants and new assessment of nuclear quadrupole moments in 135,137Ba
data.authors: Sahoo, B. K.; Barrett, M. D.; Das, B. P.
data.notes: Theory paper compiling and testing experimental B constants (electric quadrupole hyperfine coupling constants) for 135Ba+ and 137Ba+ in 6p 2P3/2, 5d 2D3/2, and 5d 2D5/2 states. Table 3 compares multiple experimental measurements. Does NOT contain new experimental A or B measurements. Used to derive improved nuclear quadrupole moments Q(135Ba)=0.153(2) b and Q(137Ba)=0.236(3) b. Published journal DOI from arXiv metadata: 10.1103/PhysRevA.87.042506. arXiv: 1303.6836.

properties.notes: B constant from Villemoes 1993 (J. Phys. B 26, 4289), reported in Table 3 of Sahoo 2013. Multiple experimental values listed: 92.5(2)[Villemoes93], 95.0(37)[Wendt84], 89.7(15)[Silverans80], 91.6(12)[Winter77], 92.5(4)[Andra76]. Most precise is 92.5(2) from Villemoes 1993. is_recommended=0 because full paper inaccessible; use Villemoes 1993 (doi:10.1088/0953-4075/26/22/030) as primary source.

B constant from Villemoes 1993 (J. Phys. B 26, 4289), reported in Table 3 of Sahoo 2013. Multiple experimental values: 59.0(1)[Villemoes93], 59.4(23)[Wendt84], 55.3(34)[Silverans80], 62.1(12)[Winter77], 60.4(4)[Andra76]. Most precise is 59.0(1) from Villemoes 1993.
B constant from Silverans 1986 (PRA 33, 2117), as cited in Table 3. Use Lewty 2013 (doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.88.012518) for more precise value: B=59.52552(11) MHz.
B constant from Silverans 1986 (PRA 33, 2117). This is the best available value for 135Ba+ 5d 2D5/2 B constant.
B from Silverans 1986 as cited. More precise value from Lewty 2013: B=44.537594(34) MHz.
